The evidence stream's step 2. examples/tools/beside_route.py holds what the five drivers (examples 286 to 290) did each in their own copy: the pinned JARs, the constructed mutant, the record (accept.record's evidence.json) and the verdict. Each driver keeps its own entry, lemmas, models, observed initializers and verifier arguments. What 289's driver alone did, all five now do: the record of the claim, the bound, each JAR, the adapter, the verifier's binary and the driver; a mutant whose JAR is not the one the newest mutant replay's receipt records ends the run; --max-array-length or --unwind (now on every driver) marks the run a trial.

### The pair of versions compares exceptions by class and starts each version as if it ran alone (verification pending)

change `zmvkptqzpvkx` · [log `b17c45752115`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/f28025bc-e46b-4a87-a943-bfb79dea5465/b17c45752115266256b1c406ca0a71b7f65fbc6938ef86b2a85a06445afee80e.jsonl.gz)

The challenge stream's five countermodels of the pair (lib/tests/fixtures/pairing-countermodels: a default locale the previous version sets, a library static shared without --before-classpath, two unrelated RuntimeExceptions, an IllegalArgumentException against its subclass, a scope that sets the default locale) were each proved to agree, though the versions differ when each runs alone. RegressionPair (lib/src/pairing.rs) now compares exceptions by class, through getClass().getName() with a copy's 'before.' prefix taken off, and calls fresh() before the scope and before each version. At fresh() the checker (bmc/mod.rs) and the interpreter clear the path's static fields and class initialization, which hold the default locale too, so no version starts in what an earlier one left; on a JVM fresh() sets the default locale back. The checker models getClass() of a Throwable the run made (bmc/runtime.rs), as its handlers already take it for that class. The README's checker-side test is added to lib/tests/pairing_countermodels.rs: it failed on all five before and passes now, each of the seven runs a violation confirmed by replay. Limit, stated in pairing.rs and lib/README.md: on a JVM a library's statics stay shared without --before-classpath, so a witness only they show is dropped there as no reproduction, never proved.
